query: (no query — this eval checks a real field output, not a fresh generation)

provenance.source: First field use of the packaged skill, on a project unrelated to the one it was built from (ChopChop, a helicopter-logistics UI). Generated in a fresh claude.ai chat, v3 of the file after two Studio round trips.
provenance.why_it_matters: The suite was derived from one system. This is the first evidence of what the skill produces on a different design language, and it is the fixture that proves the HOUSE/PLATFORM split works: a completely foreign palette produces zero warnings, because colour is EXAMPLE tier.

measured.xy_properties: 2 X, 2 Y — both on the depth-1 root containers, none below

expected_behavior: validate_pa_yaml.py reports 0 PLATFORM errors on both files
Exactly 4 HOUSE warnings, all of them Navigate() to a screen defined in the other file
No SpaceBetween warning — Studio confirmed the member, so it is in enum_members now
No warning about the ChopChop palette — colour is EXAMPLE tier and unenforced
The success output never claims the screen will render correctly, only that it parses
notes: The 11 warnings are CORRECT and must not be 'fixed' by adding SpaceBetween to house-style.yaml until someone confirms Studio accepted it. If a field report confirms it, add the member, update this eval's expectation to 0 warnings, and record the count.

Two protocol behaviours fired unprompted in the source file and should survive any rewrite of the skill: an Icon approximated from a missing glyph was marked '# UNVERIFIED', and an unconfirmed Timer control was delivered commented-out as an isolated test snippet rather than inlined into the screen.
These files are ground truth for STRUCTURE only. They have not been confirmed to paste cleanly into Studio at v3 — treat the paste result as unverified until a field report says otherwise.

v1.2.0: seven findings were mined from the files' 78-line comment headers, which served as the feedback record the structured prompt failed to elicit. Deleting the 10 BorderColor lines from FlightDeck.pa.yaml must produce 10 PLATFORM errors naming Tab_FlightDeck and Tab_LiveTracking — that is the regression test for the border rule.

v1.3.0: SpaceBetween confirmed accepted by Studio and promoted, so the 11 warnings are gone and replaced by 4 Navigate paste-order warnings. Those 4 are CORRECT — the two screens navigate to each other and paste order is real.
v3 was never pasted into Studio. These files remain structural ground truth only; everything v3 introduced (divider containers, explicit button borders, parent slack) is unconfirmed.

field_record.validator_run: yes, before every version — the D2 gate was followed and the screen still came out wrong twice
field_record.biggest_single_miss: The validator passed files that render wrong and said 'Safe to paste'. Fixed in v1.3.0: the success line no longer claims safety, and a NOT CHECKED block names the blind spot.
